name: Big South Cross Country Championships
where: Spartanburg, SC · host USC Upstate · Milliken Research Park
headline: Big South Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: Charleston Southern edged High Point 25-30 in the men's race, with Charleston Southern's Martin Iriondo winning the 8K in 23:45.2. High Point won the women's title with 38 points over UNC Asheville (67) and Charleston Southern (71), and High Point's Brianna Malone won the 5K in 16:42.6.
